audit_items.proof_trace: TOCTOU race condition in proposer index cache lookup. The cache releases lock at L116 after reading rootMap but before calling ProposerIndices at L121, allowing concurrent cache updates (Prune/Set) to invalidate or modify the epoch->root mapping between the two operations, enabling proposer_index mismatch to pass validation.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker crafts data column sidecar with incorrect proposer_index and times P2P gossip to arrive during epoch boundary when UpdateProposerIndicesInCache prunes old epochs. Cache lookup reads checkpoint->root mapping (L113-116), then concurrent Prune (L573 in beacon_committee.go) deletes the epoch entry before ProposerIndices is called (L121), causing cache miss and fallback to ComputeProposer which may compute different proposer due to state transition race, accepting invalid proposer_index.
